instrumentHub.viewSubtitle: Connect your lab equipment so the platform can pull live process data and compare it against predictions in real time.

instruments.pulseGeneratorDesc: Electroporation pulse generators (BTX, Lonza, MaxCyte) for transfection protocol execution in Module 1.
instruments.bioreactorDesc: Stirred-tank and benchtop bioreactors (Eppendorf DASGIP, Sartorius Ambr, Applikon) for live upstream monitoring.
instruments.chromatographyDesc: Preparative chromatography systems (Cytiva AKTA) for live downstream yield tracking.
instruments.hplcDesc: Analytical HPLC and product-quality instruments for in-process titer and purity measurement.
instruments.cellCounterDesc: Automated cell counters (Vi-CELL, NucleoCounter) for viability and density readings.
